lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder), altering finish layouts (finish, layout), and adding new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance.
Sign-in redesigns (sign_in, redesign) underperformed consistently, producing zero winning tests and multiple losses.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) and home wait-info updates (home, wait_info) proved helpful, driving multiple winning tests.
Adoption new screens (adoption, new_screen) generated multiple winning tests, though overall performance remained mixed with several losses.
Predictions were systematically too optimistic for failing changes, redesigns, layout shifts, and guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions systematically underestimated the magnitude of positive gains achieved by winning tests.
